units: pixels in the original 2160x1080 frame (x right, y down, origin top-left); time_s = frame / 24

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of background strips vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.01 px over all frames)
camera.view: elevated view looking down onto a street intersection; horizon near the top of the frame

perspective_cues_approx.note: ROUGH: curb lines read by eye from a 100-px grid, error maybe +-10 px at the points, large at the vanishing points
perspective_cues_approx.horizon: line through the two vanishing points, about y = 80-96 px (nearly level)
perspective_cues_approx.focal_estimate_px: about 830 px IF the two roads are perpendicular and the principal point is the image centre (HFOV about 104 deg) - very rough; prefer depth_info + a known size

taxi.motion: starts at the far side of the intersection (image ~[841,330]-[960,426]) facing the camera, drives toward the camera and turns to its right (image left), ending side-on at the left, just above the parked purple car
taxi.ref_point: mask centroid of the visible body (shadow mostly removed)
taxi.size_note: growth is mostly the change from front view to side view (turn), plus approach
taxi.occlusion: frames ~24-50: the near traffic-light pole / sign plate crosses the taxi (thin strip hidden, both sides of the pole are in the mask); f0-1 touches cyclist in the image

van.motion: parked/nearly still at the far side next to the taxi until ~f6-8, then drives toward the camera and to the right (image heading ~30 deg below horizontal), growing strongly; at f71 it fills the lower right [1399,511]-[2092,1025]
van.ref_point: mask centroid (white body + bumpers/wheels; cast shadow removed)
van.occlusion: cyclist rides along its left/front side the whole clip (overlap in image every frame); it stays inside the frame (f71 bottom y=1025)

cyclist.description: man in dark jacket and grey trousers riding a black city bicycle
cyclist.motion: starts beside the van's left front (f0 box [964,329]-[993,400]), rides toward the camera / right, staying just in front-left of the van, ends at [1444,727]-[1597,916]
cyclist.ref_point: centre of the hand-read full box (rider+bike); bottom_cx/bottom_y = wheel contact level
cyclist.occlusion: overlaps the van in the image in all frames (in front of it)

pedestrian.description: man in white T-shirt and grey jeans walking on the far-left sidewalk
pedestrian.motion: walks steadily toward image left along the sidewalk, from x~480 to x~250, at a nearly constant depth (box height ~95-110 px all clip)
pedestrian.ref_point: pelvis estimate = head top + 0.47 x 103 px (103 = median unoccluded box height)
pedestrian.occlusion: f0-~20 behind the green trash can (lower legs hidden); ~f40-60 behind the left lamp post (thin strip)

purple_car.description: parked dark-purple sedan, near left foreground, facing right
purple_car.orientation: long axis from rear (lower-left) to front (upper-right), ~15 deg above horizontal in image

green_car.description: parked teal/green coupe on far side of road B, right of centre, front pointing left

trash_can.description: green slatted trash can on far-left sidewalk

lamp_post_left.description: street lamp with twin heads on far-left sidewalk, leaning

lamp_posts_far.description: three lamp posts on far sidewalk to the right

traffic_light_near.description: large traffic-light assembly on near corner, foreground centre (occludes taxi ~f24-50)

traffic_light_far_left.description: pedestrian-sign traffic light (green lamp lit) at far-left corner

traffic_light_far_mid.description: traffic light at far corner centre

traffic_light_right.description: traffic-light assembly with red pedestrian signal on right corner

static_objects.sidewalks: far-left corner sidewalk (with lamp post, trash can, pedestrian), far sidewalk along road B (right), right corner sidewalk, near corner sidewalk bottom centre

events.event: clip start: taxi, van, cyclist close together at far side; pedestrian beside trash can
taxi starts moving (step 0.4 px at f1, 2-3 px/frame from f2)
van starts moving (steps < 0.6 px f1-6, ~1 px f7, rising steadily; rear edge fixed at x=957 until f8)
taxi turning: image heading changes from ~120 deg (toward camera) to ~155-170 deg (leftward) over f14-f25; heading ~170 deg after f55
taxi begins passing behind near traffic light / sign plate (to ~f50)
cyclist and pedestrian are moving from the first frame to the last (no start/stop observed)
clip end: all four still moving; van largest (694x515 px box)

files.background: bg.png (clean background, median of frames with van ghost patched from f71)
